sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Read
God created us for His glory. We can bring Him glory by worshipping Him alone. Today, we will read a story from the Bible about worship.
Luke 4:8
Daniel 3:1-30 (Worship in Exile)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
We should worship Jesus alone no matter the cost.
Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego would not worship the idol set before them.
Shadrach Meshach and Abednego were willing to die in order to obey and worship the Lord.
Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego were thrown into a fiery furnace for not worshipping the idol and serving the gods of the King.
The Lord delivered Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego from the fiery furnace.
Because of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego’s faith in God, the King instructed the people to worship the true God.
The Lord is the only one that deserves our worship.
When we surrender our lives to God’s perfect will, that is the worship He desires.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Are you worshipping anyone or anything other than Jesus?
If yes, take time now to repent of this and fix your eyes on Jesus and worship Him alone.
Continue sharing the gospel with your family and friends!
To whom will you tell your testimony and Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
God’s name will be made great among all people and places. Let’s commit to give our lives for the sake of His name going forth.
Malachi 1:11
Pray
Ask God to help us worship Him alone. May we be people who are willing to follow Jesus and obey His commands no matter the cost.
